properties.description:
The answer to "what is the most pressing item?" once the backlog lives in the graph. NOT detect_gaps and NOT check-health, and the distinction is the design: detect_gaps asks what the design has not yet decided, check-health asks what shape is wrong, and this asks which of the agreed things to do now. Three questions needing three actions, often from three people. A view, never a second source of truth.

THE RANKING RULE THAT MATTERS MOST: an unmade decision outranks the work waiting on it. A proposed Decision with things GOVERNED_BY it is a blocker, and pointing someone at blocked work is worse than saying nothing, because it looks like progress.

BUILT 2026-08-10 as the served `what_next`, in FOUR BANDS. (1) `marked` — open decisions carrying AUTHORED_BY role=approver, which is the user's own durable self-prioritisation and is never reordered by any score. (2) `ranked` — the top few of what is NOT marked, scored by live governed count, work it blocks in an increment, and contradictions with settled decisions. (3) `unexplored` — one decision drawn from the zero-scoring pool, a required exploration term rather than a wooden spoon. (4) `shaping` — the few ACCEPTED decisions most of the live design hangs off.

THE PREREQUISITE THAT EXPIRED UNNOTICED, kept because it is the lesson rather than the history: this capability recorded its own blocker — "distinguishing allocated from delivered needs cap:derived-completion (BL-104)" — and that dependency reached `verified` long before anyone came back to it. Nothing watches for a park whose CONDITION has expired, which is precisely what `cap:revise-trigger` exists to surface and did not. A prerequisite written into prose is a trigger nothing fires.

THE WHICH-DECISIONS-SHAPE-EVERYTHING SECTION IS BUILT, and its recorded caveat turned out to need exactly one refinement. Anthony asked for it 2026-07-31: the reader who has just cloned the repo needs the few choices that explain why the rest looks as it does. The caveat said RAW IN-DEGREE IS THE WRONG SIGNAL because the top hit was a pruning decision governing ten DROPPED requirements. Measured 2026-08-10: that decision governs 10 nodes of which 9 are retired, so EXCLUDING DEAD NODES removes it outright and nothing further was needed. Live means: not a dropped or deferred Requirement, not a superseded or rejected Decision.

BREADTH WAS TRIED AND REJECTED ON MEASUREMENT, which is worth keeping so nobody re-proposes it. Weighting by how many DISTINCT node types a decision governs is the obvious reading of "weight by what the governed nodes are" — and it demotes every exemplar named here as the right sort of thing, because functional decomposition governs eight Components and the three-party division seven Capabilities: one type each. GOVERNING EIGHT COMPONENTS IS SHAPING; SINGLE-TYPEDNESS IS NOT SHALLOWNESS. The type breadth is reported as `shapes` for the reader and deliberately kept out of the ranking.

WHAT IT STILL CANNOT DO, stated rather than left to be discovered: a Decision carries no timestamp, so staleness cannot enter any of this; and a decision nothing points at scores zero however important it is, which is why band three exists and why the size of that pool is reported rather than hidden.
properties.name: Say what to work on next, as a projection with its reasoning shown
